Pokerrrr2 Card Peek: The Mobile Poker App That Recreates the Casino Swipe

Pokerrrr · Aug 22, 2026 · 5 分で読める

Quick Answer

Pokerrrr2's Card Peek is an upward-swipe reveal mechanic. When a player swipes up, only they can see their hole cards — no one else at the table sees anything. It recreates the feel of lifting the corner of your cards at a real casino table, and it's the app's biggest point of difference from other mobile poker apps.

The Problem With Most Mobile Poker Apps

Most mobile poker apps show your hole cards directly on screen at all times. That's convenient, but it also means anyone glancing at your phone — on a train, in a waiting room, across the table at a home game — can see your hand instantly. Real casino games don't work that way: players control exactly when they look at their cards, and how.

How Card Peek Works

  1. Your hole cards start face-down on screen.
  2. Swipe up on the card area to reveal them.
  3. Release, and the cards immediately flip back face-down.

No reveal animation is shown to other players — the peek only happens on your own device. Nobody else at the table can tell exactly when, or how many times, you looked.

Why It Changes the Feel of the Game

Card Peek recreates the ritual of a real card room — the speed, timing, and frequency of checking your cards becomes a readable behavior, just like at a physical table. That adds a layer of authentic "tells" to mobile play that flat, always-visible cards can't replicate.

  • Hosts who don't want to announce phone-position rules
  • Anyone who cares about the feel of the game, not just the result

Supported Formats

Card Peek works across Texas Hold'em, Omaha, and Stud — in both private games and club games.
